collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-26  -  THE CHILD AND THE BUTTERFLY SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: A child catches a brightly colored butterfly in a soft net and notices that its wings are becoming tangled.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A child catches a brightly colored butterfly in a soft net and notices that its wings are becoming tangled.

choices.label: Lower the Net and Allow the Butterfly to Escape.
Ask an Experienced Gardener for Guidance.
Place the Net Gently on the Ground and Loosen the Opening.
Put the Net Away and Draw Butterflies Instead.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The butterfly flies away, leaving the child delighted by its colors.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The butterfly rests briefly before taking flight, and the child watches patiently.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The gardener helps free the butterfly without pulling at its wings.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The butterfly escapes before the gardener arrives, and the child decides to observe rather than catch another.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The butterfly finds its way out without further disturbance.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The child struggles with the tangled mesh and calls for assistance.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The child spends the afternoon sketching patterns from memory.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The drawings look imperfect, but the child enjoys watching butterflies among the flowers.
